LBR.note: The document does not say the financial management system is in use across central government; it covers contracts for the budget system.

facts.fact: FrontPageAfrica reports that the Ministry of Finance's Budget Management System is reconfigured and run under annual contracts with the vendor RoviaGate Technology, at US$180,000 in 2021 to 2023 and US$200,000 in 2024.
